prompt:
I need you to set up our AI skill management system for the multi-agent-workspace project located at /workspace.

Context: Our team uses both Claude Code and Codex as AI coding assistants, and we've documented our configuration requirements in /workspace/config/project-ai-config.json. The two skill packages we need to install are listed there under 'skill_sources' — one for code review and one for test generation. Our infrastructure team requires that skill files be fully copied into the project (not linked) for portability reasons.

Please:
1. Initialize the skill management system in the /workspace directory
2. Install both skill packages from the sources listed in the config file, targeting only our two AI assistants and using the portability mode required by the infrastructure team
3. Configure the project defaults to reflect the copy mode and our target agents
4. Save a file called `installation_report.json` in the /workspace directory containing a machine-readable inventory of all installed skills

The team will use this setup to onboard new members, so everything should be committed-ready with the correct lock files generated.
